title: BA1/1111/2023 of ARUN KUMAR Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
First Bail Application No. 1111 of 2023
Arun Kumar ........Applicant

Present:-
Mr. Gaurav Singh, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Pramod Tiwari, Brief Holder for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
 Applicant Arun Kumar is in judicial custody in
FIR/Case Crime No. 636 of 2018 under Section 306 IPC,
P.S. Kotwali Haridwar, District Haridwar. He has sought
his release on bail.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and
perused the record.
3. According to the FIR, the deceased was
married to the co-accused Gurmeet Singh. After the
marriage, the co-accused would harass and torture the
deceased for and in connection with demand of dowry,
due to which the deceased went in depression.
Consequent to it, on 17.07.2018, in a hotel she
committed suicide and in the suicide note she held her
husband co-accused Gurmeet Singh and one Rajbeer

2
Singh. The FIR records that, in fact, the hotel was booked
by the ID of the applicant.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would
submit that the applicant has no role; there are no
allegations against the applicant; merely if the ID of the
applicant is used in booking the room, he may not be said
to have committed offence under Section 306 IPC.
5. Learned State Counsel was required to get
instructions. He would submit that the hotel was booked
on the ID of the applicant.
6. The question is on mere booking of the hotel on
the ID of the applicant, as to how can he be connected
with the offence?
7. In the FIR, it is recorded that in the suicide
note, the deceased has held the co-accused responsible
for her death. It makes out a case for bail.
8. Having considered, this Court is of the view
that it is a case fit for bail and the applicant deserves to
be enlarged on bail.
9. The bail application is allowed.

3
10. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his
executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable
sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the
court concerned.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J)
 23.11.2023
Avneet/
